parameters.query: SELECT a.id,a.user_id,j.title,j.company_name FROM applications a JOIN jobs j ON j.id=a.job_id WHERE a.status='APPLIED' AND a.applied_at < NOW()-INTERVAL '7 days' AND a.followup_sent=false

parameters.jsCode: return items.map(i=>({json:{...i.json,message:`Follow-up due for ${i.json.title} at ${i.json.company_name}. Review the suggested message before sending.`}}));

parameters.query: INSERT INTO notifications(id,user_id,channel,subject,body) VALUES(gen_random_uuid(),$1,'in_app','Application follow-up due',$2); UPDATE applications SET followup_at=NOW() WHERE id=$3
